label: Candidates from simulation
subgoals: Simulate random input patterns to get each node's signature
Normalize signatures so complementary ones compare equal
Group nodes with equal normalized signatures into candidate classes

label: Proving with SAT
subgoals: Pick a representative for each candidate class
Ask SAT whether a member and its representative can differ
Merge the member on UNSAT and count s minus one calls per class

label: Counterexamples refine the classes
subgoals: Simulate the counterexample returned by a satisfiable query
Append its bit to every signature and split the classes
Repeat simulation and SAT until every class is proved or split
